stories.title: An Unclassified CIA System Was Breached in a Cyberattack, AP Source Says
stories.description: It was not clear what specific information was compromised or who was responsible.

stories.title: Iran-Aligned Volant Manticore Uses IPFS-Based KuboShell Backdoor in Espionage Campaigns
stories.description: Iran-aligned Volant Manticore targets Cyprus and Saudi Arabia using the IPFS-based KuboShell backdoor and a reworked MuddyWater framework.

stories.title: VMware Updates Patch Critical ESX, vCenter Vulnerabilities
stories.description: The critical bugs include an authentication bypass in vCenter and flaws that could allow code execution on ESX hosts.

stories.title: McDonald’s Japan Confirms Data Breach – Customer Information and Location Data Exposed
stories.description: McDonald’s Japan has confirmed that a third party gained unauthorized access to customer information stored in the database behind its official mobile app.

stories.title: European Commission Uncovers Data Breach in Cyberattack Investigation
stories.description: Names and email addresses of EU Academy users were exposed in the AI-assisted cyberattack the European Commission detected in October.

stories.title: Check Point Security Management Servers Hacked in AI-Assisted Campaign
stories.description: The attacks were launched from 99 IP addresses and targeted organizations across multiple industries and countries.

stories.title: Critical VMware ESX Flaws Let Remote Attackers Execute Malicious Code on Virtualization Hosts
stories.description: Broadcom has disclosed 23 VMware vulnerabilities, including two critical flaws that could let attackers run code directly on ESX hosts and a third that could let them access vCenter without signing in.

stories.title: Hackers Deploy ZQAgent Backdoor to Run Malicious Commands and Access Files on Linux Servers
stories.description: ZQAgent Linux backdoor uses ARTEX to maintain long-term access to compromised servers, steal data and evade detection.

stories.title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
stories.description: Broadcom patches 23 VMware flaws, including a critical vCenter authentication bypass that could allow unauthorized access to the system.

stories.title: Okta Links ShinyHunters-Associated Vishing Group to New INCEPTION Data Leak Site
stories.description: Okta links an active vishing cluster previously associated with ShinyHunters to the INCEPTION leak site, but its operators remain unconfirmed.

stories.title: Critical ASP.NET AntiCsrf Flaw Exploited in Attacks by triggering a web redirect on vulnerable apps
stories.description: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-131914, a critical flaw in Idunno: AntiCsrf, an old third-party library used by ASP.NET WebForms applications.

stories.title: Hackers Found a Way Around GitHub SHA Pinning. This Webinar Explains How to Close the Gap
stories.description: GitHub Actions attackers exploited SHA pinning trust gaps to disguise malicious commits, while new workflow lockfiles leave provenance risks unresolve
